title: Skeleton2D nodes with a non-empty modification_stack cannot be instantiated multiple times in the same scene
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.1.stable.mono.official.14d19694e ### System information Winwos11 - Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono.official.14d19694e - Vulkan 1.4.312 (Forward+) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU ### Issue description When a scene containing a Skeleton2D child node, whose Skeleton2D node's modification_stack property is not empty, is instantiated multiple times in other scenes, a large number of duplicate error messages will be output, all stating "ERROR: Drawing is only allowed inside this node's _draw(), functions connected to its draw signal, or when it receives NOTIFICATION_DRAW." At this time, the editor becomes abnormally laggy, the 2D skeletal animation exhibits many anomalies, and sometimes the editor even crashes directly and becomes unresponsive. But if you set the `resource_local_to_scene` property of the SkeletonModificationStack2D resource to true, this problem will not occur. ### Steps to reproduce 1. **Create a Skeleton2D scene** - Create a new scene with a Node2D as root - Add a Skeleton2D node as child - Add a SkeletonModificationStack2D resource to the Skeleton2D node's `modification_stack` property - Add at least one modification (e.g., SkeletonModification2DLookAt) - Save this scene as `skeleton_scene.tscn` 2. **Create a test scene** - Create a new scene with a Node2D as root - Instance `skeleton_scene.tscn` multiple times (at least 2-3 instances) as children 3. **Reproduce the issue** - Run the test scene - Observe the console output - The following error will spam repeatedly: ``` ERROR: Drawing is only allowed inside this node's `_draw()`, functions connected to its `draw` signal, or when it receives NOTIFICATION_DRAW. ``` - The editor will become extremely laggy - 2D skeletal animations will display abnormally - In severe cases, the editor may crash or become unresponsive 4. **Expected behavior:** - No error messages - Smooth editor performance - Normal skeletal animation display 5. **Actual behavior:** - Multiple instances of the same scene cause continuous error spam - Editor performance degrades significantly - Skeletal animations fail to render correctly - Editor may crash when multiple instances are active - Setting `resource_local_to_scene = true` on the SkeletonModificationStack2D resource resolves the issue ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [Test4.6.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25762711/Test4.6.zip)
